title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.36: Unified 'debuff' across all cards and relics behind one shared definition - a Debuff-type power OR a negative Buff (negative Vigor/Strength/Dexterity) - so Crying Out Loud, Another Brick and Greasepaint all treat it the same.
